contentHtml:
With the weekly reset, the Venomous Abyss bosses and Mythic Keystones +12 or higher now drop more Ascended Venomstones.

Ascendant Venomstones


In Patch 12.1.5. Ascendant Venomstone started to drop from various sources, allowing players to upgrade some of their end-game loot for 10 Venomstones apiece. For players who haven't completed their Venomstone grind yet, there's some great news: Venomous Abyss and high Mythic+ keystones now drop more Ascendant Venomstones!
  • Ascendant Venomstone drops increased from various sources:
    • Heroic: Each boss now drops 2 Ascendant Venomstones
    • Mythic: Each boss now drops 4 Ascendant Venomstones
    • Keystones +14 to +17: Each run drops 2 Ascendant Venomstones
    • Keystones +18 or higher: Each run drops 3 Ascendant Venomstones
Blizzard mentions that more details about this change will be coming in a future article.

contentHtml:
Pilgrim's Bounty has a small update for 2026, with Voidlight Marl being added to many quests!

Pilgrim's Bounty 2026

New to Pilgrim's Bounty 2026

There are no new cosmetic rewards for Pilgrim's Bounty this year, but quests now reward 20 Voidlight Marl for dailies and 100 for one-time quests.

 

Reputation Buff

The main Pilgrim's Bounty festivities take place at bountiful tables, which can be found in many zones in Kalimdor and Eastern Kingdoms. Various seasonal vendors and quest-givers surround the major cities' tables, offering special cooking ingredients and related daily quests.

If you eat five helpings of each of the available foods at a bountiful table, you will gain the The Spirit of Sharing buff which grants a 10% increase in reputation gain for an hour.

The Spirit of Sharing

Daily Quests

If you're looking to complete the dailies for rewards or Voidlight Marl, you're going to need a lot of Reagents that are obtained from different areas of the world. Here's a list of all the materials you will need to complete all the dailies for one day:

  • 20 Ripe Elwynn Pumpkin by Stormwind

  • 20 Teldrassil Sweet Potato by Darnassus
  • 20 Wild Turkey by Elwynn
 Horde

Rewards

Pilgrim's Bounty is a great way to level up Classic Cooking, but there are many cosmetic rewards that you can obtain! For a list, check out our Pilgrim's Bounty guide, but here's a preview of some of the rewards:

Blizzard has released a new motion comic for WoW: Forever called "Al'Aketh Rising," which follows a local Skyborne constable on Zephras Isle.

Blizzard
View Original
Constable Aonda of the Skyborne travels into a remote settlement that appears to be under strict control. Prisoners march under close guard, strangers smile with an eerie conviction, and an uncomfortable silence provides cover for a growing threat. As she plays along to get closer to the truth, she finds herself overwhelmed by hidden agendas and fanatic devotion. And in a land ruled by wind, blind devotion can become a storm.

Join Constable Aonda for a special reading of World of Warcraft: Forever's newest motion comic, “Al'Aketh Rising”.

contentHtml:
There's one week before Patch 12.1.7 launches on December 1st, which means this is your last chance to obtain the Feat of Strength achievements for Aqir Invasions!

Aqir Invasions

Achievements

Aqir Invasions are going away when Patch 12.1.7 launches on December 1st. With the removal of this content, four Feat of Strength achievements and one title will no longer be available:
  • Aqir Research Associate
  • No Hives Left Standing
  • Driving Back the Swarm
  • Bane of the Swarm
These achievements and the %s, Bane of the Swarm title are currently easier to complete due to the reputation buff from the 22nd Anniversary event.

Rewards

The Aqir Invasion rewards will have their reputation requirements removed after Patch 12.1.7 launches, but the items will cost more Voidlight Marl. If you aren't interested in the achievements or title and are comfortable paying a little more Voidlight Marl, then you can wait until Patch 12.1.7 launches to purchase the rewards.

contentHtml:
Professions have many a twist in World of Warcraft: Forever, and one of those is that you need particular Work Stations to craft certain high-level items.
To keep things simple for this article, we will refer to these objects as Profession Work Stations. We are aware that on an individual level, the items vary and may be described as Looms, Sewing Machines, etc.
While this system has been seen in other expansions, it is slightly different in Forever for a few reasons.
  • The Work Stations are crafted with the profession and consumed on use
  • You can access them anywhere you can put down a camping fire
  • These are provided by players rather than regular parts of the World
You can find below a list of the Tier 3 Blueprints for every Profession and the source. The sources have been collected from the Wowhead Looter Addon. Thank you to everyone who uses this and helps keep our database up to date.

Only crafting professions require a Work Station; for other professions, the Tier 3 Blueprints provide a different benefit. If you are still looking for your Tier 2 Blueprint, you can find it in our Camping Guide linked below.

Camping Overview


ProfessionEffectSource
Alchemy Blueprint: Alchemy Laboratory: Places an Alchemy Laboratory for recipes that require one, plus Mana regenerationRas Frostwhisper Scholomance
Blacksmithing Blueprint: Master Forge: Places a Master Forge for recipes that require a Forge, plus increased StrengthGolem Lord Argelmach Blackrock Depths
Enchanting Blueprint: Arcane Forge: Places an Arcane Forge for recipes that require one, plus increased Armor, All Stats and ResistancesNanaya Shapers Terrace
Engineering Blueprint: Anarchist's Workbench: Places an Anarchist's Workbench for recipes that require oneEzra Grimm Stratholme
Herbalism Blueprint: Seed Hybridizer: Places a Seed Hybridizer that multiplies or combines seeds into rarer tiers, plus increased IntellectTendris Warpwood Dire Maul
Leatherworking Blueprint: Sewing Machine: Places a Sewing Machine for recipes that require one, plus the Camp Tent Rested XP benefitVectus Scholomance
Mining Blueprint: Molten Foundry: Places a Molten Foundry for recipes that require one, plus increased melee Attack PowerAmbassador Flamelash Blackrock Depths
Skinning Blueprint: Trapper's Workbench: Places a Trapper's Workbench containing 1 trap, plus 2% Critical StrikeThe Beast Blackrock Spire
Tailoring Blueprint: Loom: Places a Loom for recipes that require one, plus increased SpiritBaroness Anastari Stratholme
Cooking Blueprint: Iron Oven: Places an Iron Oven that allows Cooking and up to 10 additional camp featuresQuartermaster Zigris Blackrock Spire
Cooking Blueprint: Iron Oven: Places an Iron Oven that allows Cooking advanced recipesQuartermaster Zigris Blackrock Spire
Cooking Blueprint: Expert Campfire: Places an Expert Campfire that allows Cooking and up to 10 additional camp featuresSlavecrusher Grox Krol'dok Stronghold
First Aid Blueprint: Plague Doctor's Laboratory: Places a Plague Doctor's Laboratory that provides Healing Potions and poulticesDoctor Theolen Krastinov Scholomance
Fishing Blueprint: Fishing Hut: Places a Fishing Hut to catch rare fish for 1 hour, plus Fishing Skill lures and 8% statsJammal'an the Prophet Sunken Temple


Blueprints are tradeable, and you can buy them from the Auction House, but Tier 3 Blueprints are currently quite costly, so you may want to farm your own. The NPCs that drop Work Stations also drop reagents required to craft them.

You can buy the individual Work Station, but as it is consumed on use, it is unlikely to solve your problems in the long term.

contentHtml:
Blizzard has announced hotfixes for today, which includes more class and profession bug fixes!

For Combat
  • Tier Set fixes for Feral Druids
  • A bug where spells and abilities were causing more procs than intended was fixed.
For Crafting
  • Food involving clams now offer Well Fed bonuses.
  • Multiple pattern bug fixes.
For Everyday Players
  • World Buffs now persist when changing areas.
  • Obsidian Sentinel in Uldaman drops loot again.
  • Multiple quests in Wetlands and Riverglades have been fixed.
Blizzard
View Original

Hotfixes

November 23, 2026

Classes
  • Druid
    • The 4-piece Feralheart set for Druids now correctly grants 4 Energy regeneration every 1 second for 5 seconds.
  • Priest
    • Mind Vision should no longer proc effects.
    • Shadow
      • Fixed an issue where Dark Inspiration was not granting the correct amount of %Spirit increase if Mind Flay was used to activate it.
      • Fixed an issue where Chastise was not usable in Shadowform.
  • Warlock
    • Destruction
      • Fixed an issue where Intensity was not working on Incinerate.
  • Warrior
    • Fixed an issue where players could have and use Mortal Strike from their spellbook, even without the Mortal Strike talent. This does not remove it from their spellbook but prevents it from being used without the talent point spent.
Dungeons
  • Uldaman
    • The Obsidian Sentinel drops loot as intended.
Items
  • The Filcher’s Cowl no longer has a level requirement.
Professions
  • Cooking
    • Boiled Clams, Clam Chowder, Goblin Deviled Clams, Giant Clam Scorcho, Undermine Clam Chowder, and Clam Linguine each now offer the correct Well Fed bonuses and have been recategorized in the recipe list under “Stamina Food”.
    • Murloc Fin Soup has had its recovery and Well-Fed amounts increased to the next tier of food, bringing it closer to other food of that level.
  • Engineering
    • Fixed a bug that caused Goblin Engineer’s Renewal Gift and Gnome Engineer’s Renewal Gift to appear as broken, unusable question marks in the inventory.
    • Fixed a bug that prevented “The Mortar: Reloaded” recipe from being learned upon learning the “Goblin Mortar” recipe.
  • Leatherworking
    • Fixed a bug that prevented Pattern: Centaur Hoofwarmers from being learnable.
Quests
  • Riverglades - Dunston Willis once again runs near the end of the escort “Dunston Checks Out.”
  • Wetlands - After further study, the quest “For Further Study” now has rewards.
  • Wetlands - The quest “Uncovering the Past” now rewards Ironforge reputation.
  • Wetlands - The quest “Gleaning Our Future” now rewards Ironforge reputation.
Races
  • Fixed an issue where Wisp Form could be applied to players while they were alive.
Spells
  • Fixed an issue where a few spells and abilities were causing more weapon procs than intended.
  • Fixed an issue where World Buffs would fall off when changing areas. They will still fall off when entering raid instances.
  • Fixed an issue where Fengus’ Ferocity was granting twice as much Spell Power as intended.
  • Fixed an issue where Darkmoon Faire buffs were granting twice as much power as intended.

title.en: Players Reporting that Sunder Armor Effects Don't Work in WoW: Forever Dungeons
title.es: Los jugadores informan de que los efectos de «Romper armadura» no funcionan en WoW: Mazmorras Eternas

summary.en: Players Reporting that Sunder Armor Effects Don't Work in WoW: Forever Dungeons...
summary.es: Los jugadores informan de que los efectos de Romper armadura no funcionan en WoW: Mazmorras Eternas...

contentHtml:
According to the Classic WoW community Github, Sunder Armor effects don't work in WoW: Forever dungeons.

Sunder Armor Basics

In World of Warcraft, a creature's armor reduces their physical damage taken. In Classic versions of WoW, some classes have abilities that reduce the armor of enemy targets:
  • Druid: Faerie Fire
  • Rogue: Expose Armor
  • Warlock: Curse of Recklessness
  • Warrior: Sunder Armor
Applying these debuffs is a large increase for physical damage dealers, such as Warriors, Hunters, and Rogues, but everyone who does some melee damage will see some benefit.

Sunder Armor in Forever Dungeons

Sunder Armor effects are important for increasing damage in WoW: Forever, but according to the Classic WoW Community Github, they don't actually work in dungeons. Multiple reporters have looked into the logs and damage numbers and concluded that these Sunder Armor effects work in the open world, but not in dungeons.
ToxicKevinFerm said:
In dungeons, Sunder Armor, Faerie Fire, Curse of Recklessness and Expose Armor lower the target's armor in the combat log, but players and pets physical hits are mitigated as if the debuff was not there. The share of each hit removed by armor does not move.

This also happens to the player who applied the debuff: a warrior's own hits get nothing from their own Sunder Armor. Seen in every level 60 dungeon checked: Blackrock Spire, Stratholme, Scholomance, Dire Maul, Blackrock Depths, The Shaper's Terrace and Blackmaw Hold. NPCs are not affected: Aurius's hits on Baron Rivendare follow every Sunder Armor stack in the same fight where the players hits stay flat. In the open world the debuffs work for players.
They note that on the The Beast encounter, a level 60 players should be having their physical damage reduced by 14% with Faerie Fire and Sunder Armor active, but as of right now, it's 40% physical damage reduction.

This hasn't been confirmed by Blizzard at this time, but players have reported that this bug has been in the game for a while, possibly since Beta. As of right now, pressing these buttons doesn't reduce the armor of enemies, but it can still generate threat in the case of Sunder Armor.
